senses.gloss:
मिह् (औ) मिहौ r. 1st cl. (मेहति)
 1. To sprinkle, to shed.
 2. To emit seminal water.

मिहिका f. (-का)
 1. Frost.
 2. Snow.
 E. मिह् to sprinkle, aff. क्वुन् ।

मिहिर m. (-रः)
 1. The sun.
 2. A sage.
 3. A cloud.
 4. Air, wind.
 5.
The moon.
 6. An old man.
 E. मिह् to sprinkle or scatter, (radi-
ance, &c.) Unādi aff. किरच् ।

मिहिराण m. (-णः) A name of ŚIVA.
 E. मिहिर the sun, अन् to live, अच् aff.
